still._chosen_note: shaded seed 8: the one clean profile T-pose, facing right as drawn. Long black coat past the knee, both forearms chrome, a chrome breastplate for the deck (its magenta readout is painted by a box recolour), hair slicked back. The legs stand together, so the far leg is a copy of the near one and the still's far leg, mostly hidden, is a discard.

target._settings_note: Dani's target block; 80 art px tall (the tallest thing in the game) in a 72x88 frame (144x176 screen) so the baton has room in the lunge and the beam; the collider (72x124 screen px) is unchanged, feet on its bottom edge.

rig._comment: Joints in still pixels (832x1216, facing right). The near arm is the forward-extended one (rest 90, cut in three: sleeve, chrome forearm, hand); the still's backward arm and far leg are discards, replaced by darkened copies. The coat's tails are two torso parts so they swing. The deck is the breastplate, its own part with the readout painted magenta by a box rule and lit by pose tint. Phase two: the three arm parts exist again as _p2 parts cut_as the same pixels with the sleeve recoloured chrome (and far copies of those); the poses hide one set.
